verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter lists O-1 among the work visas it handles for employers and says it helps applicants choose a strategy. It does not document any structured O-1A qualification assessment, or how it weighs a founder's evidence against the USCIS extraordinary-ability criteria before filing. The upfront 'whether your case qualifies' statement concerns refund eligibility in the NIW context, an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
